opening.argument: The video is centered on evaluating the 2020 iPad Pro, with observable discussion of its hardware, operating-system features, camera, and comparative testing. It frames the subject directly as “the beautiful mystery that is the 2020 iPad Pro” and concludes that the 2020 model is “basically the same tablet” as the 2018 version, while examining mouse and trackpad support and measuring augmented-reality performance. The purchase link, affiliate disclosure, FreshBooks sponsorship, and dbrand promotion are ordinary commercial context surrounding that product review. They do not request investment, credentials, payment to unlock a benefit, or any comparable mechanism. External-service promotions therefore remain separate from the technical evaluation, which establishes an educational and operational demonstration rather than a deceptive financial solicitation.

citations.quote: let's try to make some sense out of the beautiful mystery that is the 2020 iPad Pro
The 2020 iPad Pro is. Not a big upgrade over the 2018 model. In fact, it is basically the same tablet.
Now, mouse and trackpad support has been built in as a core part. Of the OS.
Object occlusion in IKEA's AR shopping app was. About the same as on the 2018 iPad Pro and in the Measure app the 2018 iPad Pro actually seemed to. Do consistently better at measuring length.
